title: Choosing the Right General Contractor in Scarsdale
excerpt: When you're planning a renovation or addition in Scarsdale, you need a contractor who understands both the work and the permitting. Silvio Luca brings architect credentials and hands-on construction experience to every project.
content:
Scarsdale homeowners have high standards for their properties. The architecture here reflects real care, with homes that range from classic colonials to mid-century designs. When you decide to renovate, add on, or restore, you want someone who respects what's already there and knows how to do the work right.

Finding the right person matters more than you might think. A general contractor who can also talk architect is rare. That's what you get when you work with Silvio M. Luca at House Architecture & Construction. He's both a licensed architect in New York and a licensed general contractor in Westchester, which means he understands the design side and the construction side equally well.

What Sets This Approach Apart

Most homeowners deal with two separate people: an architect who designs the work, then a contractor who builds it. That handoff creates gaps. Questions come up during construction that nobody anticipated. Change orders pile up. The vision gets lost in translation.

When one person holds both licenses and runs the project personally, things work differently. Silvio oversees every phase. He's the architect on your job site, not someone checking in once a month. That means the design actually gets built the way it was meant to be. No surprises about cost or timeline because the same person who designed it is the one executing it.

Experience Across Westchester Homes

Scarsdale isn't his only focus. Based in Eastchester, Silvio serves all of Westchester County, from Bronxville to Rye and everywhere in between. That means he's seen every type of home, every building department, and every kind of challenge. He knows how Scarsdale's permit process works because he's done work throughout the area.

His work includes home renovations of all sizes, additions that change how a home lives, second-story additions that double your footprint, kitchen remodels that actually get used, bathroom renovations that feel like a retreat, and primary suite additions that give you the master bedroom you've always wanted. He also handles historic restorations for homes with character you want to keep, open-concept conversions that modernize a floor plan, and custom new construction for people building from scratch.

Why Scarsdale Homeowners Call Him

Scarsdale has older neighborhoods where homes need thoughtful updates. It has newer sections where additions and renovations happen all the time. Silvio knows how to add to a Scarsdale home without making it look like it was added to. He understands proportion, materials, and the character of the community.

When you call for a free consultation, you're not talking to a salesperson. You're talking to the architect and contractor who will run your project. That conversation is where real work begins.
